snippet.title: Humanity Echo - 0.0.8.pre Combat Teaser | New Tactical Maps
snippet.description:
A first look at Humanity Echo 0.0.8.pre - an upcoming combat-focused update for our cyberpunk tactical RPG.

This preview shows new tactical combat maps, refreshed visuals, improved combat presentation, environmental hazards, squad actions, and the first step toward a stronger playtest build.

Humanity Echo is a story-driven cyberpunk tactical RPG set in Odesa, 2044. Lead an engineer and a small squad through grid-based missions, faction pressure, loot, upgrades, and difficult choices in a city that is still trying to survive.

Wishlist / Play the demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3865080/Humanity_Echo_Cyberpunk_Tactical_RPG/

Developer: Sympathy Systems

#HumanityEcho #CyberpunkRPG #TacticalRPG #IndieGame #GodotEngine
